story.dialog_quest_and_story_engine_exam: The Dialog, Quest and Story Engine is ready.
Create your own story entries in your Resource Pack under assets/<namespace>/dqse/story_entries/.
example.villager.name: Villager
example.dialog.greeting.text: Hello, traveler! What brings you here?
example.dialog.greeting.choice.ask_quest: Do you have work for me?
example.dialog.quest_info.text: As a matter of fact, I do. Would you help me out?
example.merchant.name: Merchant
example.dialog.merchant.intro.text: Welcome to my shop! Care to take a look at my wares?
example.dialog.merchant.wares.text: Finest goods in the realm. Anything catch your eye?
example.dialog.merchant.deal.text: For you, a special price. Do we have a deal?
example.gatekeeper.name: Gatekeeper
example.dialog.gatekeeper.gate.text: Halt! No one passes without a pass.
example.dialog.gatekeeper.checkpoint.tex: A valid pass. Noted. Come back when you wish to enter.
